response.subject: This week at Yale: sweet treats, game night, dinner
response.intro: Reader and college are unknown, so this week's picks lean toward free food and open events.

picks.line: Free sweets from Silliman GA before break, but it's Silliman students only.
Free Hot Murga after a talk on culture, consent, and care.
Free dinner for the AACC November recess, open to everyone.
Casual game night at AACC, a good low-key way to meet people.
Short wellness check-ins with the Good Life Center, no prep needed.
Physics seminar on quantum 2D materials, for anyone curious about the science.
Handsome Dan weighing tradition at Beinecke Plaza, a fun Yale ritual to see.
